name.full: Resemble AI Authenticity for Copilot Cowork

description.short: Analyze media and text for AI generation with Resemble AI.
description.full: Use Resemble AI to analyze audio, images, video, and text for synthetic content. Submit a media link or workspace attachment, retrieve detection results, and ask follow-up questions grounded in a completed report. Optional media intelligence adds context and supported audio source tracing helps investigate synthesis origins. Requires a Resemble account with access to the requested capabilities; analyses may consume account credits. Detection is probabilistic and does not establish identity, intent, factual truth, or legal proof.

agentConnectors.description: Authenticated media and text detection with asynchronous results and grounded follow-up analysis.
